Steel is the backbone of Arcforge. It takes two multiblocks.
# 1. Coal coke
Build a Carbonizer and bake coal into coal coke. It needs no fuel, just time, and gives creosote as a by-product.
# 2. Steel
Build the Arcforge Furnace. Burn coal coke to heat it to 1,200°C, then feed it iron ingots and coal coke: each smelt makes a steel ingot and some slag.
See the Steelmaking chapter for both builds.
